content.short: Stake Unused CNFTs From Beloved Collections & Invent New Worlds. Earn Passive Income, Build In-Game Assets & Trade.
content.description:
Cardano Lands - the first of its kind DeFi platform on Cardano Blockchain where you can stake your CNFTs from beloved collections to earn daily rewards. Make your CNFTs work for you instead of letting them sit in your wallet! Each CNFT will generate Hexonium energy that can be used for Inventing new Elements in Metalab!

A virtual economy based on a fantasy world that promotes real interaction between numerous projects, including CNFT collections, exchanges, wallets, and staking pools. The platform has unique mechanics of getting daily rewards and converting them into new CNFTs that can be used for trading or for even more upgrades.

Become a part of a friendly community and lets together evolve Cardano Network - https://linktr.ee/cardanolands
